triage.summary: KubeSolo runtime is unhealthy due to a missing containerd socket file, causing pods to fail image pull and restart loops.
triage.cause: The containerd socket at /var/lib/kubesolo/containerd/containerd.sock does not exist, matching the 'runtime' component failure. This is a common issue on edge devices where the containerd binary is not running or the socket directory was not created.
